python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', sheet_name='Budget', header=None)
exp = df.iloc[9:22]  # EXPENSES section (rows 10-22 in Excel, 0-indexed 9-21)
exp.columns = ['category','item','amount']
exp = exp.dropna(subset=['amount'])
exp['amount'] = exp['amount'].astype(float)
print('=== Per-category totals ===')
print(exp.groupby('category')['amount'].sum().to_string())
print()
print('Total expenses across all categories: %.2f' % exp['amount'].sum())
print()
print('Item count:', len(exp))
"
